questions.question: After facing a twelve-year delay, a major new bridge across the Yalu River has finally opened, linking China with which neighbouring nation?
questions.explanation: The New Yalu River Bridge connects the Chinese city of Dandong with Sinuiju in North Korea.
questions.context: China–North Korea relations: The New Yalu River Bridge connecting Dandong, China, and Sinuiju, North Korea, opens following a 12-year delay.

questions.question: The International Bureau of Weights and Measures decided that which timekeeping adjustment will be phased out from May 2027?
questions.explanation: Officials voted to eliminate leap seconds to ensure Coordinated Universal Time remains continuous, opting instead for occasional leap hours if needed.
questions.context: At the General Conference on Weights and Measures, the International Bureau of Weights and Measures votes to abolish future leap seconds and make Coordinated Universal Time (UTC) continuous, starting 20 May 2027. To account for future differences between UTC and International Atomic Time, a leap hour will be observed as needed.

questions.question: Police in which South American capital arrested at least 25 individuals following clashes at a student and staff protest over university funding?
questions.explanation: The arrests took place in Buenos Aires after protests against higher education funding cuts turned violent.
questions.context: Argentine police arrest at least 25 people after clashes during a university funding protest in Buenos Aires, while eight police officers are injured.

questions.question: A maritime rescue operation was initiated after a commercial vessel flying the flag of which microstate caught fire off the coast of Romania?
questions.explanation: Seven crew members went missing when a tanker registered in San Marino caught alight in the Black Sea.
questions.context: Seven people are missing after a San Marino-flagged tanker catches fire off the coast of Romania amid recent drone attacks on merchant shipping in the Black Sea. Search and rescue operations are underway to locate the missing crew members.

questions.question: Jeffrey Donaldson, who was sentenced to 15 years in prison following a criminal trial, previously served as the leader of which political party?
questions.explanation: Donaldson is a former leader of Northern Ireland's Democratic Unionist Party (DUP).
questions.context: Northern Irish politician and former Democratic Unionist Party leader Jeffrey Donaldson is sentenced to 15 years in prison for child sexual abuse and rape. The offences occurred between 1985 and 2008.
